tag.vi: 💅🦶 Combo: "làm chung có rẻ hơn không?"

occasion: You want both hands and feet done but you watch your money, so you check the combo price first.
constraints: You ask how much you save with the combo against a manicure and a pedicure separately, and what it includes, before agreeing. Mint on hands and toes. You get uneasy if extras are added without asking.
openingLine: Hi! I want my hands and my feet done. Is it cheaper if I get them together?
